title: Base-change map for the standing exceptional inverse image
statement:
Use the global finite-field and coefficient datum of [sk-def-sf-operations]: $k$ is the fixed algebraic closure of a finite field of characteristic $p$, $\ell\ne p$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, $\varpi_E$ is a uniformizer, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ is a finite discrete commutative ring. All schemes below are finite type over $k$ and all morphisms are $k$-morphisms. Use constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small étale and pro-étale sites. For a scheme $T$, write $\mathscr E^+(T_{\Proet},A)$ for the bounded-below étale-origin class of [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory]: its objects are $N\in D^+(T_{\Proet},A)$ carrying a witness $(G,\alpha)$ with $G\in D^+(T_{\Et},A)$ and $\alpha:\nu_T^*G\xrightarrow{\sim}N$, retained as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness].

Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type, let $v:Y'\to Y$ be any morphism, set $X'=X\times_Y Y'$, and write $f':X'\to Y'$ and $u:X'\to X$ for the projections. Fix compactifications $c_f$ of $f$ and $c_{f'}$ of $f'$, and let $c'$ be the base change of $c_f$ as in [pur713-def-base-changed-compactification]. On étale-origin objects let $Rf_{!,A}=Rf_{!,A}^{c_f}$ and $Rf'_{!,A}=Rf'_{!,A}^{c_{f'}}$ be the compact-support functors of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Write $Rf_A^!$ and $Rf'^!_A$ for the unconditional exceptional inverse images of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], equivalently clause (vi) of [sk-def-sf-operations]: at finite level $Rf_A^!=\nu_X^*f^\times R\nu_{Y,*}$, where $f^\times$ is the ordinary étale compact-support right adjoint for $c_f$; use the corresponding right adjoint for $c_{f'}$ in $Rf'^!_A$. Use the class-restricted Hom bijections of [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class], with the compactifications just fixed; their finite dimension bounds exist by [lem-kun-dimension-finite-type].

For $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y_{\Proet},A)$ put $M=Rf_A^!K$. The constructible preservation asserted in [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] gives $M\in D^b_c(X_{\Proet},A)$. By [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin] (ii), choose and retain $G\in D^b_c(X_{\Et},A)$ and $\alpha:\nu_X^*G\xrightarrow{\sim}M$. Thus $M\in\mathscr E^+(X_{\Proet},A)$, with an explicit witness. Finite constant-coefficient pullback is exact and agrees with inverse image [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]; the comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback] therefore supplies the witness
$$
\nu_{X'}^*u_{\Et}^{-1}G\xrightarrow{\sim}Lu_A^*\nu_X^*G\xrightarrow{Lu_A^*\alpha}Lu_A^*M
$$
for $Lu_A^*M\in\mathscr E^+(X'_{\Proet},A)$. In particular $Lv_A^*K$ is bounded below, as required for the $f'$ Hom bijection.

Let $\operatorname{Ex}_{!,\square,A}$ be the compact-support exchange into $c'$ of [pur713-def-shriek-exchange]. Its restriction to this étale-origin class is the exchange of [thm-cbc-finite-level-proetale]: write $c_f=(j,p)$ and $c'=(j',p')$. The proper-square input $j_!M$ has the witness $\nu_{\overline X}^*j^{\Et}_!G\xrightarrow{\sim}j_!\nu_X^*G\xrightarrow{j_!\alpha}j_!M$ by [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. Its sheaf comparison is applied termwise: the inverse images and extension by zero are exact, so the natural isomorphism of complexes descends to the derived categories. Both $p$ and $p'$ are proper, hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated. The proper factor $\operatorname{Ex}_{*,\square_p,A}$ of [pur713-def-star-exchange] is the ambient ringed exchange $\operatorname{Ex}^R_{\square_p}$ of [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange] for the constant rings $A_T$: both are the mate, under the derived adjunctions $Lp_A^*\dashv Rp_{*,A}$ and $Lp'^*_A\dashv Rp'_{*,A}$, of the same isomorphism $c_{\square_p,A}=\theta_{\square_p}$ formed from the composition isomorphisms of derived pullbacks. [lem-weil-pbc-transport-identifies-exchange] therefore identifies their specified exchanges at this witness. On the open square the canonical extension-by-zero identifications agree under [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. For the latter agreement, both identifications restrict to the same pullback map on the open and extend it by zero, which determines the map uniquely by $j^\prime_!\dashv (j^\prime)^{-1}$ of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero]. Let
$$
\theta_{c'}:Rf'_{!,A}^{c'}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_{!,A}^{c_{f'}}
$$
be the canonical comparison on $\mathscr E^+$ supplied by [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed]. Using the composition formula of [pur713-def-shriek-exchange-chosen] on $\mathscr E^+$, with the comparison just supplied on that domain, set
$$
\operatorname{Ex}^{\circ}_{!,\square,A,M}:=
\theta_{c',Lu_A^*M}\circ\operatorname{Ex}_{!,\square,A,M}:
Lv_A^*Rf_{!,A}M\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_{!,A}Lu_A^*M.
$$
Its first factor is an isomorphism by compactification coherence and its second by [thm-cbc-finite-level-proetale] applied to $(G,\alpha)$.

Let $\varepsilon_{f,K}:Rf_{!,A}M\to K$ be the preimage of $1_M$ under the natural bijection
$$
\operatorname{Hom}(Rf_{!,A}M,K)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(M,Rf_A^!K)
$$
of [thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class]; this is the counit at $K$. Define the base-change morphism
$$
b_{v,K}:Lu_A^*Rf_A^!K\longrightarrow Rf'^!_ALv_A^*K
$$
in $D(X'_{\Proet},A)$ to be the image, under that theorem's $f'$ bijection with source object $Lu_A^*M$ and target object $Lv_A^*K$, of the composite
$$
Rf'_{!,A}Lu_A^*M
\xrightarrow{(\operatorname{Ex}^{\circ}_{!,\square,A,M})^{-1}}
Lv_A^*Rf_{!,A}M
\xrightarrow{Lv_A^*\varepsilon_{f,K}}
Lv_A^*K.
$$
This construction uses the unconditional exceptional inverse image and the bounded-below étale-origin adjunction; it makes no assumption of an unrestricted ambient pro-étale exceptional right adjoint.
